business_summary: Okamoto Industries, Inc. manufactures and sells industrial and household products in Japan, North America, Asia, and internationally. It offers industrial products, including plastic films for general goods, stationery; wallpaper for housing, decorative films for kitchen cabinets, doors, building materials, moldable ABS and acrylic sheets, and synthetic leather for sofas and furniture; automotive materials; agricultural films/work materials; and food wrapping films, absorbent/dehydrant sheets, gloves, and other food sanitation materials. The company also provides adhesive tapes and rubber bands; flexible container bags; medical/welfare products comprising wound dressing materials, medical gloves, autoclaves, masks, and other sanitary materials; and industrial products, such as cleanroom gloves, adhesive mats for entrances, partition films, safety shoes, and other products. In addition, it offers household products consisting of condoms/lubricants, heat patches/heating pads/hot water bags, health goods, portable sanitary products, and gloves; dehumidifiers, cockroach control products; absorbent/dehydrant sheets, food wrapping films, and sheets for cooking; rubber boots, safety shoes, and marine wear; and leather shoes and sneakers. Further, the company engages in the logistics and solar power generation business. Okamoto Industries, Inc. was incorporated in 1934 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.
